record.body:
## Rationale

`scripts/test.sh` passes `--no-project` and then re-supplies pytest, textual, pip, setuptools, and wheel with `--with`. Once the project declares its libraries, that flag hides them. `uv run pytest` uses the project environment, so runtime libraries come from `[project].dependencies`. pytest, pytest-xdist, httpx, pip, setuptools, and wheel are test tools, so they go in the `dev` dependency-group, which `uv run` includes by default. The phase-gate command is already `scripts/test.sh`, so the suite picks this up without a config change. README, AGENTS.md, and the suite fallback strings drop the old flags so a reader does not resurrect them.

## Counter-argument

Putting pytest and pytest-xdist in `[project].dependencies` matches the monorepo plan's single list and needs no dependency-group. `uv run pytest` would still work. The cost is that an installed orchestra tool would depend on pytest.

payload.alternatives: pytest and pytest-xdist in project dependencies; leave test.sh on --no-project --with
payload.choice: pytest, pytest-xdist, httpx, pip, setuptools, and wheel live in the dev dependency-group, and scripts/test.sh runs uv run pytest with no --no-project and no --with
